concerns.text: Tasks T037 and T038 implement 'topological attractor analysis' (correlation dimension, Lyapunov exponent) and 'phase transition' interpretation. These tasks have no corresponding Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC) in spec.md. FR-003 strictly limits complexity metrics to Lempel-Ziv and Permutation Entropy. This represents unapproved scope creep where tasks exist for requirements that do not.

Task T018 mandates an ANCOVA model (`Post ~ Pre + Fatigue`) as an 'exploratory robustness check'. Spec.md FR-004 explicitly restricts the analysis to 'Pearson or Spearman correlation' and frames findings as 'associational rather than causal'. There is no FR or SC authorizing ANCOVA. This task implements a statistical method not present in the spec.

Tasks T014 and T015 are marked as unimplemented (`- [ ]`). These tasks are the sole implementation path for FR-003 (Lempel-Ziv complexity and Permutation Entropy calculation). The absence of implementation status for these tasks means FR-003 currently has no executable task to deliver the required artifacts.

Task T010 is marked as unimplemented (`- [ ]`). This task is the sole implementation path for FR-002 (preprocessing with bandpass filter and line noise removal). The absence of implementation status for this task means FR-002 currently has no executable task to deliver the required artifacts.

Task T026 requires a memory verification test on a dataset with 'at least N=30 participants'. Spec.md SC-001 and DC-001 define the *target* cohort size (N=30) but do not guarantee a public dataset of that exact size exists. The task lacks a fallback strategy or explicit handling for the case where the real dataset is smaller than N=30, creating a potential gap where the verification step cannot be satisfied if the data source is insufficient.
